title: VooPoo ITO Replacement Pods Fixed-Coil Pods -  2 Pack
description: The Voopoo ITO pod cartridge is designed for use with the Voopoo Doric Q pod kit and features improved leak and condensate prevention, e-liquid visibility and a clean and easy side-filling system. Available in three MTL (mouth-to-lung) resistances, the Doric Q and ITO pod cartridge allows for a range of MTL and RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) experiences while lasting up to ten days of average use. With the ITO pod cartridge, the coil is fixed and doesn’t require replacing; instead, you replace the whole pod when it begins to lose flavour, saving you time and expense. Best used with Classic/High PG , 50/50 and Nicotine Salts e-liquids. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
